page.layout: One scan: the front board of a binding, blind-tooled leather or vellum with ornamental borders. No printed text block.
page.notes: Not a printed page. The scan shows the outside cover, with blind-stamped ornament and, in the top panel, three stamped capitals reading roughly "D", "R" and "C", separated by ornaments. These are tooling on the binding, not printed text, so they are not transcribed. At the far left edge a fragment of stamped or printed lettering is partly visible ("LY" and a stroke), too cut off to read. Stains and wear on the boards are not text.
